references.title: en.wiktionary: eher
references.supports: Adverb; chiefly from a haplology of MHG ērer; no German surface split

notes.rationale: kein Unglück, eher umgekehrt, no misfortune, rather the opposite. An ADV takes no Source (ADR 0050), so DWDS's Grundform line names none. DWDS gives no Wortzerlegung, so it is a bottom word, and indeclinable, so it has no Ending, not even ∅ (ADR 0051): the Root eher alone.
